title: RAMA: Retrieval-Augmented Multi-Agent Routing with Episodic Memory for LEO Satellite Networks
abstract: arXiv:2610.42068v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Low-Earth orbit (LEO) satellite networks present a challenging routing environment due to rapidly changing topology, traffic, and link conditions. Existing deep reinforcement learning (DRL) routing methods typically rely on current observations and information encoded in network weights, limiting their ability to exploit successful past experiences. We propose RAMA, a retrieval-augmented multi-agent DRL framework with Approximate Information State (AIS), in which each satellite combines its local observation, recent routing history, neighboring state information, and retrieved entries from a per-satellite episodic memory. Retrieved experiences are integrated through a Transformer-based decision network trained with AIS-based auxiliary objectives. With weights frozen in a 140-satellite Kepler constellation, RAMA reduces mean end-to-end latency by 13.4% and 99th-percentile latency by 66.7% relative to the state-of-theart double deep Q-ne

translated_title: RAMA：面向低轨卫星网络的基于情景记忆的检索增强多智能体路由
translated_abstract: 低地球轨道（LEO）卫星网络由于拓扑、流量和链路状况的快速变化，构成了一个极具挑战性的路由环境。现有的深度强化学习（DRL）路由方法通常依赖于当前观测和网络权重中编码的信息，这限制了它们利用过去成功经验的能力。我们提出了RAMA，一个带有近似信息状态（AIS）的检索增强多智能体DRL框架，其中每颗卫星将本地观测、最近的路由历史、邻居状态信息以及从每颗卫星的情景记忆中检索到的条目相结合。检索到的经验通过一个基于Transformer的决策网络进行整合，该网络使用基于AIS的辅助目标进行训练。在一个140颗卫星的Kepler星座中以冻结权重进行测试，与最先进的Double Deep Q-Network方法相比，RAMA将平均端到端时延降低了13.4%，将99分位时延降低了66.7%。
tldr: RAMA提出了一种结合每颗卫星情景记忆检索与近似信息状态辅助训练的多智能体深度强化学习路由框架，使卫星能够复用历史成功经验，在140颗卫星的Kepler星座中将平均端到端时延降低13.4%、99分位时延降低66.7%。
en_tdlr: RAMA is a retrieval-augmented multi-agent DRL routing framework that combines per-satellite episodic memory retrieval with Approximate Information State-based auxiliary training, enabling satellites to reuse past successful experiences and reducing mean end-to-end latency by 13.4% and 99th-percentile latency by 66.7% in a 140-satellite Kepler constellation.
